description: Multi-account Google Workspace MCP server — Gmail, Calendar, and Drive with smart routing. Plugin for Claude Code and Gemini CLI.

tool_signatures.name: gws.accounts.add
tool_signatures.description: Connect a new account (waits up to ~60s; returns pendingId if slower)

tool_signatures.name: gws.accounts.complete
tool_signatures.description: Finalize a pending OAuth flow (only needed if add/reauth returned pendingId)

tool_signatures.name: gws.accounts.reauth
tool_signatures.description: Re-authorize an account (waits up to ~60s; returns pendingId if slower)

tool_signatures.name: gws.contacts.directory_search
tool_signatures.description: Search the Workspace org directory (returns name, emails); Workspace accounts only

tool_signatures.name: gws.contacts.search
tool_signatures.description: Search your own contacts by name/email/phone (returns name, emails, phones)

tool_signatures.name: gws.docs.insert_text
tool_signatures.description: Insert literal text at a location

tool_signatures.name: gws.docs.read
tool_signatures.description: Read a document as plain text

tool_signatures.name: gws.docs.replace_text
tool_signatures.description: Replace all occurrences of a literal substring

tool_signatures.name: gws.mail.forward
tool_signatures.description: Build a forward draft of a message (does not send)

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.add_tab
tool_signatures.description: Add a new empty tab to a spreadsheet

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.append
tool_signatures.description: Append rows after a table (additive, never overwrites)

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.clear
tool_signatures.description: Clear values in a range (formatting left intact)

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.duplicate_tab
tool_signatures.description: Duplicate a tab (with formatting) inside a spreadsheet

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.read_range
tool_signatures.description: Read a single A1 range from a spreadsheet

tool_signatures.name: gws.sheets.write_range
tool_signatures.description: Write cell values to a range

tool_signatures.name: gws.slides.batch_update
tool_signatures.description: Apply raw Slides API requests to a presentation

tool_signatures.name: gws.slides.get
tool_signatures.description: Read a presentation (slide count + per-slide text)

tool_signatures.name: gws.tasks.create
tool_signatures.description: Create a task (due is RFC3339; only the date is stored)

tool_signatures.name: gws.tasks.list
tool_signatures.description: List tasks in a list (add showCompleted for done tasks)
